thread:
anu: FYI bringing up quantumon-v1 q7_dynamic in the cluster and the multilang sanity suite is blowing up on short mixed spans. CJK sentence with an embedded Arabic fragment loses bracket attachment and reverses digits.
yuki: Can you drop a tiny repro + how you ran it?
anu: Ran local smoke using the cpu_compat fallback. Command:
```
./ci/eval --model=models/quantumon-v1:q7 --suite=multilang_smoke --input=tests/cjk_inline_ar.json --batch=1
```
Input snippet:
```

```
(removed control chars for slack; actual input is: 全文（مرحبا ۱۲۳）を確認しました。)
Observed output:
```
(مرحبا ٣٢١）全文を確認しました。
```
Digits mirrored and closing paren moved after the Arabic span.
sofia: Metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU=28.4 -> q7_dynamic=19.8 on this mini-suite. chrF down ~-6.2. Token mismatch +44/180, concentrated where RTL scripts are nested inside CJK punctuation.
yuki: Is this q-level specific? anu: quick checks: q8 dynamic ok; q5 has micro glitches; q7 worst. Also only seen with runtime.fallback=cpu_compat; GPU path doesn't reproduce so far.
eval-bot: auto-ticket created id=ml-smoke-3182025000-z; model_sha=bbd1a4; repo=infra/models/quantumon-v1; kernel=cpu_compat_v2
anu: run config snippet:
```
quant:
  scheme: q7_dynamic
  per_channel: true
runtime:
  fallback: cpu_compat_v2
tokenizer:
  detok: detok-unified-v1
```
sofia: detok-unified-v1 is the detok we bundle with quant artifacts. We recently merged detok-unified-v2 into fp16 packs which has explicit bidi-preserve flags. Hypothesis: q7 packer is still using v1 and packer may be dropping ZWJ/BIDI markers when compressing small token spans.
yuki: I'll try repacking q7 with detok-unified-v2 and re-run the suite. If that clears it we either update the quant packer or patch the runtime detok.
anu: logs uploaded to s3://redwood-triage/3182025000/quantumon-q7-logs.tar.gz
infra-bot: Canary pause: quantumon-v1 q7 auto-promotion disabled in ap-southeast-1 until triage. reason: locale regression.
yuki: quick grep in the packer output shows packer step `pack_tokens()` replaces U+200D with U+200B for sequences < 6 codepoints in q7 artifacts. That would drop combining behavior for short spans.
sofia: losing U+200D could explain bracket reattachment and mirror flag loss. Plan: (1) repack q7 artifacts forcing U+200D preserved; (2) if repro disappears, push packer change; (3) otherwise bisect cpu_compat_v2 detok kernel.
anu: mitigation: route CN/JP with embedded RTL to quantumon-v1-fp16 for customers and add a temporary routing rule in the canary policy.
yuki: will add a unit test to multilang_smoke that asserts bracket attachment and numeric order for a few hand-picked samples and make it a pre-promote gate for quant builds.
sofia: created RI-1600 and added failing sample id qm-mix-3182025000 to tests/multilang_seeds.json
infra-bot: rollback condition: BLEU delta >4 on canary suite or >2 user errors/min -> auto-route to fp16.
anu: thanks team. marking monitored. reactions: :mag: :warning:
yuki: I'll post bisect results here by EOD PST and push a repack candidate early tomorrow.
sofia: I'll take the test PR and add a tiny fuzz set for short mixed spans to avoid future regressions. thanks everyone."
